evidence: Has the 'Private Broadcast' label and modifies private broadcast tracking in src/private_broadcast.{cpp,h} and src/net_processing.cpp.
rationale: Retains completed and echoed private broadcast transactions so operators can inspect send history and reception confirmations. As the PR notes, previously broadcast data would 'vanish as soon as the transaction is echoed from the network', but this is an observability enhancement rather than a fix for relay failures or origin privacy issues.
